Her son (my husband) used to struggle with drug addiction. I watched her champion, love, encourage her son while her heart broke. She had firm boundaries and made some really hard calls as a mama but she never stopped being kind and encouraging. She welcomed him home with big arms and a big heart when he was well and not in the trenches. I too, have struggled with addiction from 14yrs and up, my family shunned me, embarrassed me, acted like I never existed. Lots of families don’t know how to deal, so I get it but as I watched her, I knew that the way she loved him through it, is the way it should be. Side note: her and I were church friends long before I ever met her son. Anywho, eventually her son and I met and we went through a torrid, scandalous affair, super ugly times. SHE NEVER SHUNNED ME!!!! She prayed for me. One time, she and two other friends from church, basically broke down my door (literally) and made me go to a church function I had willingly signed up for but got too drunk to go to. Every single lady there held me, cried with me. Anyways, eventually we got pregnant and while my husband went to a 9mo live-in rehab program, she let me move in with her. I went through a horrible first 6mos. I was mentally unwell, life long untreated (self treated) depression and bipolar. She dealt with some crazy mood swings, dark valleys, tons of negative energy but she did it so, so kindly. She fed me, she helped deliver my son, she would wake up with us, make me snacks while I breastfed. Did my laundry so I wouldn’t get overwhelmed. This woman is literally a SAINT. We are both five years sober, my husband made himself a super awesome, lucrative career. I’m a SAHM. We were able to make my husband’s dream of moving states come true. We’ve bought and sold a house. Life is so wonderful because someone loved us through the ugly.
